evidence_plan.requirement: Different correlations resulting from different variants of ROUGE scores

payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how different ROUGE variants correlate with manual evaluations, indicating variability in effectiveness.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in varying correlation values with manual Pyramid scores, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
Among all variants, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 show better correlations with manual judgments in scientific summarization.
ROUGE-L and its weighted version ROUGE-W have weak correlations with Pyramid scores.
